summary.text: Steven Sanders, a No Labels Party write-in candidate and U.S. Army veteran, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Arizona's 4th Congressional District to Greg Stanton.
A Phoenix native, he has worked as an aviation mechanic and manager.

paragraphs.text: Sanders was born in Phoenix, Arizona. According to Ballotpedia, he graduated from Sunnysloe High School (as Ballotpedia spells it) and attended Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University.
He served in the U.S. Army from 1986 to 1991, and his career experience includes work as a manager and as an aviation mechanic with an FAA airframe and powerplant license.

Sanders ran as a write-in candidate for U.S. Senate in Arizona in 2024, listed as an Independent, and received 92 votes (0.0 percent). Ballotpedia lists him as affiliated with the Roosevelts Rough Rider and the Boy Scouts of America.
He ran as a No Labels Party write-in candidate for Arizona's 4th Congressional District.
Steven Sanders lost to Greg Stanton, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
